reforms.description: The R&D tax credit was made permanent in 2015, providing ongoing financial support for research and development activities, while the Fixing America’s Surface Transportation (FAST) Act established a competitive grant program aimed at supporting economically beneficial projects that facilitate improved freight movement. Additionally, proposals to establish a patent box regime have been discussed to lower the tax rate on income from patents and intellectual property, enhancing competitiveness.
reforms.component_name: R&D Tax Credit and FAST Act Grants
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The reforms provide financial incentives for R&D and innovation, which are expected to enhance productivity and competitiveness.
reforms.status_evidence: The R&D tax credit was made permanent and the FAST Act was enacted.
reforms.importance_rationale: The reforms represent significant changes in the funding landscape for R&D and innovation support.
reforms.source_quote: The Fixing America’s Surface Transportation (FAST) Act signed in December 2015 established the Nationally Significant Freight and Highway Projects competitive grant program aimed to support economically beneficial projects that will facilitate improved freight movement.

reforms.description: The federal R&D budget should be protected from expenditure cuts, ensuring continued investment in research and development.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Protecting the R&D budget is crucial for maintaining investment in innovation and research activities.
reforms.status_evidence: The proposal to protect the R&D budget has been stated but not yet implemented.
reforms.importance_rationale: This reform is a major policy initiative aimed at securing funding for R&D.
reforms.source_quote: The federal R&D budget should be protected from the expenditure cuts.

reforms.description: An important step in increasing tertiary education attainment in STEM fields is improving access to quality secondary education.

reforms.importance_rationale: This reform is significant for enhancing the educational foundation for future innovators.

reforms.description: The proposed FY2017 budget includes a community college partnership tax credit aimed at encouraging businesses to hire graduates from community and technical colleges, thereby enhancing employer engagement in education and training pathways.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: This tax credit is designed to improve workforce development and align education with industry needs.
reforms.status_evidence: The proposal for the tax credit has been announced but not yet implemented.
reforms.importance_rationale: The reform is significant for enhancing the connection between education and employment.
reforms.source_quote: The proposed FY2017 budget also calls for a community college partnership tax credit.

reforms.description: Proposals to establish a patent box regime have been discussed, which would lower the tax rate on income from patents and intellectual property to enhance competitiveness.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Lowering tax rates on patent income is expected to incentivize innovation and investment in R&D.
reforms.status_evidence: The proposal for the patent box regime has been discussed but not yet implemented.
reforms.importance_rationale: This proposal is significant for enhancing the competitive landscape for innovation.
reforms.source_quote: A number of proposals to support R&D further has included calls to establish a so-called patent box.

reforms.description: The introduction of the America Invents Act in 2012 aimed to reduce patent processing times, which has been a significant barrier for small firms seeking to innovate and grow.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Reducing patent processing times facilitates innovation by allowing firms to secure patent protection more quickly.
reforms.status_evidence: The America Invents Act was enacted and is in force.
reforms.importance_rationale: The Act represents a major reform in the patent system aimed at enhancing innovation.
reforms.source_quote: After the introduction of the America Invents Act in 2012, the US Patent and Trademark Office made progress in addressing the application backlog and reducing the time for examiners to review applications.

reforms.description: The recommendation to make R&D tax credits refundable for new firms aims to enhance the financial support available to startups, thereby encouraging innovation and entrepreneurship.

reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Improving broadband access is essential for enabling research and innovation in underserved areas.
